title: Monitoring Brain Waves in Response to Visual and/or Auditory Stimulation in Parkinson's Disease Patients
brief_summary: Voltage fluctuation as a result of brain activity will be recorded into the computer using an EEG device.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

• Patients with Parkinson's disease that are ambulatory and can sign a written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with Parkinson's disease who are not ambulatory
* Patients with dementia
* Patients that are blind
* Patients that have severe hearing impairment
